errors.text: The proposed intervention—introducing an unspecified quinary-or-higher composition—is not operationally defined and largely restates the starting material class.
The mechanism invokes irradiation-defect recombination even though the problem concerns thermal and chemical instability during catalysis, with no irradiation condition specified.
It misses the target system's key instability mechanism: active diffusion, shape-dependent Au/Cu surface segregation, melting, and evaporation rather than sluggish diffusion or entropy stabilization.
No specific composition, nanoparticle size, crystal morphology, atmosphere, exposure duration, heating rate, or matched untreated control is defined.
The falsification experiment provides no quantitative stability metric or failure threshold, making the stated falsification rule circular.
